name: Local Sites
description: One-click local preview for your web projects: detects Next.js, Vite, Astro, Nuxt, SvelteKit, PHP, static sites and WordPress plugins, starts them in a visible Orca terminal, shows logs and errors, and opens the site in your default browser.

settings.title: Confirm before start
settings.description: Show the command and the port and ask before a project is started. You can change the port there.

settings.title: Open in browser when ready
settings.description: Try to open the browser as soon as a started server is ready. Orca only allows this right after a click, so it may need one more click on Open in browser.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.description: Notify when a server stops unexpectedly, cannot start or shows errors.

settings.title: Ready hint after an agent
settings.description: When an agent finishes in a project that is not running, show a hint and a notification.

settings.title: Start after an agent finished
settings.description: Start the dev server right away when an agent finishes in a project that is not running. Skips the confirmation.

settings.title: Agent for Fix with agent
settings.description: The agent that the Fix with agent button launches in the project's workspace.

cover.alt: The Local Sites panel in Orca's sidebar: three web projects with status, start and stop buttons, an Open in browser button and an errors list

screenshots.alt: Projects with a favorite star, an install-and-start button, a ready hint after an agent, a running server with errors and a Fix with agent button
screenshots.caption: Confirm the port, start, see ports and errors
